# Outlook iOS Boilerplate — Copilot instructions

This repository is the **iOS endpoint** of the Outlook Design System.

Follow the agent instructions in `AGENTS.md` at the repo root: it declares the endpoint + guard and points to the iOS rules + shared guardrails in the `ods-kb/` submodule. Read ODS specs **only** from `ods-kb/ods/iOS/` — never `ods-kb/ods/windowsWeb/` or other platform directories.

> Note: GitHub Copilot does not expand `@import` the way Claude Code does, so this file restates the key pointers. The canonical rules are maintained upstream in `x3-design/outlook-design-system`; do not copy them here.
